claim: Instant Payments are initiated 'via Fifth Third Direct (Real-Time Payments payment type)'; 'RTP is a payment type in FTD'.
finding: The FTD 'How do I initiate payments' guide lists New Payment types for Account Transfers, Wire and ACH (incl. Same Day ACH) only, with no RTP or instant-payment type. The cited S074 Historical Data guide shows 'Real-Time Payments' only as a filter in Historical Payments search, and says it does not support initiation. The Security Procedures (Oct 2025) route Instant Payments through Data Exchange file upload in FTD and the API channel. The FTD transition page tells migrated Comerica clients to use same-day ACH or wires and says they can receive RTP only.
resolution: Instant Payments (RTP) are originated by Data Exchange file upload in Fifth Third Direct or through the API channel (Instant Payments API / Newline). No single-entry RTP type appears in the FTD 'How do I initiate payments' guide. RTP items are searchable in FTD Historical Payments. Migrated Comerica clients are receive-only ($1 per item).

finding: The $218M and the 42% (vs $153M) are correct. But 1Q26 includes two months of Comerica (merged 2/1/2026). The release says year-over-year noninterest income comparisons were 'primarily driven by merger-related impacts'. It does not split commercial payments revenue between legacy Fifth Third and Comerica, so 42% is not organic growth.
resolution: Commercial payments revenue $218M in 1Q26, +42% YoY including two months of Comerica (merged 2/1/2026); organic growth not disclosed.

claim: Fifth Third is a 'top-10 ACH originator' [S068,S069,S103].
finding: None of the three cited sources contain an ACH-originator ranking. The Barclays deck, Q1 release and MCP press release were checked. Nacha's 2025 Top 50 list supports the claim: Fifth Third Bancorp is #8 ODFI (413.9M originations) and #13 RDFI.
resolution: #8 ACH originator (ODFI) and #13 receiver (RDFI) in Nacha's 2025 Top 50 [S951].

claim: Mobile Deposit with Immediate Funds: segments ['consumer','small_business'].
finding: The bank's own App Store listing disclosure says Immediate Funds is not available to business accounts.
resolution: FITB-P04-S02 segments = ['consumer']. Business accounts get standard mobile deposit only.

claim: ACH Positive Pay: decide before 12:00 p.m. ET to post same day, else next day; default decision applies if missed.
finding: The ACH Welcome Center page has two windows. The 'First window: 12:00 p.m. ET' is for same-day posting of return decisions, and there is a 'Final deadline: 8:00 p.m. ET'. The default decision applies only after the final deadline. The chapter's wording implies 12 p.m. is the only deadline.
resolution: Return decisions before 12:00 p.m. ET post the same day; final decision deadline 8:00 p.m. ET; default Pay/Return decision applies after that.

finding: Fifth Third's own consumer and business Zelle pages document live enrollment and send/receive, so the evidence is CONFIRMED_BANK. Also, the participation baseline.zelle is still 'unknown' and should be updated.
resolution: zelle = true, CONFIRMED_BANK [S001,S003,S901,S907]. Flag the participation baseline.zelle → true.

claim: Direct Express is mentioned only as a differentiator ('planned bill pay, cardless ATM and wallet features'), not as a money-movement product.
finding: Fifth Third has been the Treasury's Direct Express financial agent since 9/9/2025 (5-year agreement, ~3.4M cardholders). SSA says new Direct Express enrollments with Fifth Third began in May 2026, and existing cardholder accounts move 'later this year or early next year'. It is a live consumer prepaid benefits-disbursement product that Fifth Third operates. The 'planned features' (bill pay, cardless ATM, wallets) were not corroborated by SSA.
resolution: Record Direct Express as an inventoried program in the observations: Fifth Third is the financial agent (since 9/9/2025), new enrollments since May 2026, Comerica-issued accounts migrating late 2026 / early 2027. Keep it out of the rail product list until accounts migrate. Treat the planned features as bank-stated only (S102).

claim: Commercial payables products (Integrated Payables, Managed Payables, Healthcare Payables / Choice Disbursements, Commercial Card) are listed only in extra.other_treasury_products, not as products or sub-products.
finding: 53.com's sitemap lists 'Integrated Payables', 'Managed Payables' and 'Healthcare Payables' under Commercial Payments as products. 'Fifth Third Choice Disbursements for Patient Refunds' pays recipients by digital prepaid card, bank transfer (ACH), check or physical card. 'Fifth Third Commercial Card powered by Brex' is the default commercial card and is marketed with 'real-time payments'. These are money-movement disbursement products that the schema's 'every named product' rule requires.
resolution: Add P08 sub-products 'Integrated / Managed Payables' (multi-rail AP: ACH, wire, check, card; vendor payment-method campaigns) and 'Choice Disbursements for Patient Refunds' (digital prepaid card, ACH, check, physical card). Commercial Card powered by Brex stays adjacent (card program).

claim: 2026-03-20: Cash flow/spending insights ('Plan' tab), Direct Deposit Switch, Debit Card Tracker.
finding: The 3/20/2026 release launches 'Plan' (cash-flow and spending insights). It lists Direct Deposit Switch and Debit Card Tracker next to SmartShield as features already in the award-winning app. The 5/29/2025 J.D. Power release already cited direct-deposit switching and real-time debit-card order tracking, so these are not 2026 launches.
resolution: 2026-03-20: 'Plan' cash-flow and spending insights launched (bottom navigation). Direct Deposit Switch (1,000+ employers) and Debit Card Tracker were existing features (cited May 2025).

finding: Labor Day 2026 fell on Monday, September 7. The press release (dated 9/8/2026) says the conversion was 'executed over Labor Day weekend'. 9/8 is the date of the announcement and of full FTD access, not Labor Day.
resolution: Conversion executed over Labor Day weekend (Sept 5–7, 2026); completed and announced 9/8/2026.

claim: Newline Same Day ACH windows 8:50 a.m. / 1:20 p.m. / 2:50 p.m. ET.
finding: Raised as a test: a WebFetch summary of the Newline ACH doc gave cut-offs of 8:45/1:15/2:45 ET. The rendered page table (browser) shows 'Recommended cut-off time' 8:45/1:15/2:45 and 'Sameday payment window' 8:50/1:20/2:50.
resolution: Keep 8:50/1:20/2:50 ET as the window times. Adding the recommended cut-offs is optional and not patched.

finding: The Barclays deck (S068) says only '2025 Improved Jeanie 3.0 released', with no month. Web search found no dated Jeanie 3.0 release. The J.D. Power award is dated 5/29/2025 (S920).
resolution: 2025: Jeanie 3.0 released (month not published); 2025-05-29: J.D. Power #1 regional-bank mobile app satisfaction.

claim: Zelle send has a scam_warning_interstitial = true.
finding: The only bank-documented in-flow warning is the name-mismatch warning (Personal Banking FAQ). The 'send only to people you know / no purchase protection' text in J01 REVIEW_AUTHORIZE/1 is FAQ copy, not evidence of an interstitial. SmartShield's 'Zelle fraud identification before you pay' is undescribed. A scam-specific interstitial is not evidenced.
resolution: Keep scam_warning_interstitial = true with other_flags.scam_warning_basis = 'name-mismatch warning (CONFIRMED_BANK S902); SmartShield Zelle fraud identification advertised; scam-specific interstitial copy unpublished'. J01 REVIEW_AUTHORIZE/1 reworded as below.

finding: No push-to-card product was found on 53.com (sitemap, hub, app listing) or in the Newline docs. But absence on public pages does not prove absence, for example for the external-transfer instant option behind login or commercial disbursements. Choice Disbursements uses a digital prepaid card, not Visa Direct / Mastercard Send. the participation baseline has 'unknown'.
resolution: Leave push_to_card = false (INFERRED) in the chapter, add an open question, and leave the participation baseline 'unknown' until settled. It would be settled by a logged-in external-transfer screen or a bank or network statement on Visa Direct / Mastercard Send origination.
